name: Snapchat
description: The chat list: each chat as one item you can open, with its name, status and initials; Map, Chat, Camera, Stories and Spotlight as tabs. A chat: who wrote what, the pictures in it, and a field that sends with Enter. Snapchat ignores some taps and scrolls Relaid sends, so the pack asks to touch the screen there, and to show a chat's pictures.
